DRNAREA: StreamStats delineation, or NLDI basin where StreamStats mis-snapped (basin_source; area within 10 % of NWIS either way), 2026-10-13
PRECIP: PRISM Climate Group, 1991-2020 normals, annual ppt, 30 arc-second
JANMAXT: PRISM Climate Group, 1991-2020 normals, January tmax, 30 arc-second
I24H2Y: NOAA Atlas 2 (Miller and others, 1973), western U.S. 2-yr 24-hr grid, NOAA HDSC digitization (15 arc-second, NAD27)
ELEV: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second DEM via the 3DEPElevation ImageServer, computeStatisticsHistograms at 30 m
BSLOPD: USGS 3DEP via the 3DEPElevation ImageServer, Slope Degrees raster function, basin mean at 30 m
SOILKSAT: NRCS STATSGO2 (U.S. General Soil Map) via Soil Data Access, retrieved 2026-10-13: horizon ksat_r thickness-weighted per component, components weighted by comppct_r, rasterized at 15 arc-seconds (in./hr)
VOLCQP: USGS State Geologic Map Compilation (Horton and others, 2017, DS 1052, doi:10.5066/F7WH2N65) via the energy.usgs.gov State_Geological_Map_Compilation feature service, retrieved 2026-10-14: percent of basin on units with generalize 'Igneous, volcanic' and age_max Pliocene or Quaternary, 15 arc-second raster
VOLCQP_OG: Oregon: DOGAMI Oregon Geologic Data Compilation release 8 (OGDC-8; Darin and others, 2025) via the gis.dogami.oregon.gov Public/OGDC MapServer layer 2, retrieved 2026-10-18: percent of basin on units with ThematicRockType volcanic rocks, vent and pyroclastic rocks or volcaniclastic rocks and a ThematicAge beginning no earlier than the Pliocene; outside Oregon (TIGERweb boundary) the VOLCQP SGMC mask; 15 arc-second raster
LAKEAREA: USGS NHD high-resolution Waterbody (hydro.nationalmap.gov nhd MapServer layer 12), retrieved 2026-10-14: percent of basin under FTYPE 390 (LakePond) or 436 (Reservoir) with AREASQKM >= 0.05, 5 arc-second raster
